tasks.description: Wire the renderer self-restore into src/ui/ask/AskView.js using the two pure helpers (no new IPC channel; D1). (a) Initialize isInputFocused=false in the constructor and bind handleInputBlur + handleVisibilityChange via .bind(this) following the existing constructor binding convention (~:761-768). (b) Add @blur=${this.handleInputBlur} adjacent to the existing @focus binding on #textInput (~:1425); handleInputBlur calls focusRestoreDecision.onBlur(document.hidden, this.isInputFocused, () => buildSnapshot(textInput.selectionStart, textInput.selectionEnd)) and stores this._caretSnapshot + isInputFocused from the result. (c) In connectedCallback add document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange) after existing IPC setup; in disconnectedCallback remove it (alongside existing teardown ~:844-865) to avoid leaks. (d) handleVisibilityChange: when document.visibilityState==='visible' AND shouldRestoreOnVisible(this._caretSnapshot), defer to requestAnimationFrame and call focusTextInput() then apply clampRange(this._caretSnapshot, textInput.value.length) via setSelectionRange; then clear this._caretSnapshot. (e) Extend focusTextInput() to optionally apply a caret range inside its existing rAF (reuse :960-967, do not add a second deferral). Null-guard #textInput. Guards: FR-004 (no snapshot -> no-op), FR-005 (no click-through change), FR-006 (rAF after show).
